title: Parking App
description: Showing the real time data and predictions of parking spaces.

options.label: Show only these municipalities, comma-separated. Easiest is the name in any language — "Bolzano - Bozen, Merano" and "Bozen, Meran" both work. Internal ids also work and are stable across renames: "osm:r47207" (Bolzano - Bozen), "osm:r47283" (Meran - Merano), "osm:r47317" (Bruneck - Brunico). Leave empty to show all.

Show only these car parks, comma-separated station codes — e.g. "105, 113" or a full "urn:parking:skidata:..." code. This is how you build a fixed dashboard for one operator or district. Leave empty to show all.

Show only these data providers, comma-separated. Currently published: SBB, skidata_dynamicdata, GARDENA, FBK, FAMAS, skidata, "Municipality Merano", "Municipality Bolzano", STA, Swarco. Leave empty to show all.

Show only car parks with these statuses. Live means a reading newer than "live-max-age"; delayed means older but still within "stale-max-age"; static means the car park publishes no live availability at all. Select none to show every status.
Never show these car parks, comma-separated station codes — e.g. "105, 113". Applied on top of every other setting, so a car park listed here stays hidden even if "parkings" names it.

Which filters the visitor may change, comma-separated from: municipality, parking, origin, status, excluded. Use "none" to hide the filter bar completely and lock the view to whatever the settings above define.
Offer the per-card menu that lets a visitor hide a single car park. Ignored when "excluded" is not among the filters above, because a hidden car park could then never be restored.
Include car parks that publish no live availability.
Preset the free-text search box, e.g. "fiera".
How recent a reading must be to count as real time. A number with a unit: s, m, h, d, mo — e.g. "30m", "2h".
Readings older than this are not shown at all. Same format as "live-max-age" — e.g. "6mo", "30d".
How often to poll for new readings, e.g. "60s", "5m".

Interface language, ISO 639-3. "auto" follows the visitor's browser and shows a language switcher; picking one pins it and removes the switcher. Station names follow the choice wherever the operator publishes a translation.
Override the initial map centre as "lon,lat", e.g. "11.35,46.50". Empty fits the view to the data.
Override the initial zoom level. Only used together with "center".
